title: The Hotel From Hell
scenario: Ada reserves two standard rooms for one night; 1200 pennies per room, gold-tier discount, total 2160 pennies; room inventory 8 to 6; one disposable receipt.

observations.label: Basil has expanded the tariff rulebook
observations.meaning: The tariff routine nests guest tier, room representation, group rates, coupons and statement-delivery policy.
observations.limitation: LOC and weighted metrics are available; branch/depth/return counts are zero despite visible branching, and finding rows are absent.

observations.label: Manuel has supplied two calculators
observations.meaning: The direct and agency calculators duplicate validation and integer rate arithmetic.
observations.limitation: Ruby emits no clone records for this source; compare the source manually and defer detection.

observations.label: The desk sends the paperwork in a circle
observations.meaning: There is a safe local import cycle, with imported values used after initialization.
observations.limitation: A cycle does not prove a startup failure.

observations.label: Basil keeps a process-wide notebook
observations.meaning: Quoted totals or bookings remain in a shared process-global collection until explicitly cleared.
observations.limitation: Mutable Ruby arrays are visible in source, but no state-resource records are emitted.

observations.label: Basil and Polly disagree on the room form
observations.meaning: Standard room offers and annex offers represent the same domain with different keys.
observations.limitation: These object/hash shapes have no contract or dictionary-shape records in this provider.

observations.label: Polly adjusts the actual room notebook
observations.meaning: Reservation decrements the caller-owned room mapping in place; behavior checks verify object identity and remaining rooms.
observations.limitation: The dynamic stock field has no dedicated argument-mutation finding; source and tests supply that evidence.

observations.label: Polly coordinates one successful booking
observations.meaning: The short demo legitimately coordinates a booking and disposable receipt persistence.
observations.limitation: Orchestration is intentional; no finding targets this coordinator. Absence of a finding is not proof of design quality.

observations.label: One desk owns billing and the filing cabinet
observations.meaning: One class owns guest-facing presentation, receipt state and persistence as well as billing coordination.
observations.limitation: No refactor proposal is emitted. Review ownership manually; the empty Candidates view is not approval.

observations.label: Manuel copied the guest checks too
observations.meaning: Booking creation and guest preview repeat name presence, type and blank checks.
observations.limitation: The repeated source is visible, but no validation-pattern record is promised.

observations.label: Sybil requests a queue; Basil adds departments
observations.meaning: Cancellation, cached replay, guest holds, retry limits, booking creation and event history interact in one processor.
observations.limitation: A weighted score does not establish a runtime bottleneck; Ruby branch metrics are incomplete.

observations.label: The queue has three competing notebooks
observations.meaning: Pending jobs, receipt cache and event history are module-owned mutable resources.
observations.limitation: Static ownership does not prove safe reentrancy, cache lifetime or cleanup outcomes.

observations.label: Polly receives the same job objects back
observations.meaning: Loading keeps caller job references; processing mutates attempts/state and returns different success and skipped-result shapes.
observations.limitation: Tests prove the demonstrated alias effects; broad lifecycle correctness and non-Python shape inference are unestablished.
